newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel, PLO resume Hebron talks despite attack.
newsitem.headline: Israel, PLO resume Hebron talks despite attack.

text.p: Senior Israeli and Palestinian negotiators resumed talks on the fate of Hebron on Wednesday despite a shooting attack by an Israeli soldier that wounded seven Arabs in the West Bank city, a PLO official said.
"The talks have restarted," the official told Reuters.

PLO and Israeli security sources said Israeli Defense Minister Yitzhak Mordechai began talks with chief PLO negotiator Mahmoud Abbas at 7:00 p.m. (1700 GMT) at the home of U.S. Ambassador to Israel Martin Indyk.

An off-duty Israeli soldier sprayed bullets at Palestinian shoppers in a produce market in the heart of Hebron on Wednesday in an attempt to sabotage the imminent handover of 80 percent of the West Bank city to PLO self-rule.
